method: Two independent recomputes directly from raw DATA/ATLAS/5s/<day>.parquet for each of the 100 sampled days -- no import/call into pipeline/detectors.py. (1) A clean-room reimplementation of the causal 8.0pt close zigzag + the STALL candidate/pending state machine (VOID/FAILED/10-min emit + de-dup), written fresh from the documented spec, run bar-by-bar from day-start (previous-evening 18:00 ET) through the full file so the running leg state matches what a live engine would carry; matched every recorded row by (ts, peak_ts) and diffed dir/peak_px/mfe_pt/give_frac/stalled. (2) A maximally-independent check using ONLY raw close prices plus the CSV's own recorded dir/peak_ts/peak_px/mfe_pt: walked close[peak_i+1 .. ts] directly to recompute give_frac and the stalled flag (threshold 0.30), and separately checked the VOID condition (did price ever extend >0.25*mfe past peak_px in the leg direction before ts, which per spec should have voided the candidate entirely). OUTCOME: race/resolve_s/sym_race/sym_resolve_s/net_60m recomputed via a fresh forward scan (60min horizon, 16:00 ET hard clip, NEW_EXTREME vs GIVEBACK_50 race, +-10pt symmetric race). Cross-checked against reports/causality_audit.md's truncation-replay result (0/4302 mismatches on a separate 40-day sample). Investigated the give_frac distribution (mean 3.43, 87/100 rows >1.0, max 15.875) by hand-tracing the most extreme case (2026_03_05 10:17:20 ET, mfe=8.0pt, give_frac=15.875 -> 127pt giveback) bar by bar against raw 5s closes: a real, continuous ~127pt decline over 9.5 minutes, not a bad print or bug -- an inherent property of the metric (minimum-MFE 8pt candidates open liberally throughout any leg's life and are then measured against a full 10-min forward giveback, so a huge fraction legitimately 'fail' the 30% giveback bar); flagged as a design/power observation, not a defect.
result: 100/100 PASS. peak_px, mfe_pt, give_frac, stalled, dir all matched raw-data recompute to floating-point precision on all 100 rows via both independent methods (max abs diff 8.9e-16 on give_frac). race/resolve_s/sym_race/sym_resolve_s/net_60m outcome fields matched exactly. No VOID-condition violations (no emitted candidate whose leg had, per spec, already extended far enough to disqualify it). No causality violation, no index/timestamp desync.
